package.name: gazebo_mimic_plugin
package.description: Gazebo Classic Model plugin that emulates URDF <mimic> joint behaviour (which Gazebo Classic 11 does not support natively). Each configured joint is slaved to a master joint as angle = master* multiplier + offset on every world update. Used to drive the RoboMaster EP 12-bar arc gripper's finger joints from the single actuated gripper_m_joint in simulation.
